name: Ghost Haven
themeHolders: Bryn holds both halves; Torie doubles Devotion. Nobody else in the family carries Hearth — that half faces OUTWARD, to whoever is not family yet, and Sage named the guest cottage after it.
wings: CHEEKS — two sweeping wings, Shrine on one side and Bubble on the other. The house is Belladonna Vargas's ass and the wings are the cheeks of it.
orientation: Faces north/south. The garden is the SOUTH side. The LEFT artery is the EAST CHEEK.
bathrooms: FOURTEEN — 3 main floor, 3 Right Cheek, 3 Couch section, 2 basement (one private for Zephi, one for the Speakeasy), 3 Left Cheek. NONE in the Library Tower.
cap: Sixteen couples, thirty-two girls. The house expanded on every adoption and then stopped. Not crowded. COMPLETE.
nickname: None. Torie tried to give it one and Bryn reached her first and made thinking optional for about an hour. Specter Haven is the only house with a door-name because of it.
thesis: Shaped by the land into Belladonna Vargas's body — warmth, curves, gravity. Built beam by beam by the girls who live in it.
location: Southern Woods, 200-acre property. Wildwood Hearth stands between it and Specter Haven.
lead: Brynnhildr Eriksson — the jeweler, the steady hands, the heroine who holds the world together with wire and devotion.
mood: Ghost Haven is the hearth that holds you. It whispers that you are safe. Every stair, every door, every floorboard carries their fingerprints — this house was not given, it was made.

seasons.winter: Hearthfire crackling, windows frosted. Blankets piled high in the lounge, cocoa steaming. The gym echoes as the lake freezes; laughter spills into snowball fights.
seasons.spring: Ivy's garden bursts green, herbs pressing the glass. Muddy boots by the door, laundry lines heavy with pastel and ribbon. Rae reads on the porch while Violet braids flowers into hair.
seasons.summer: Rooftop BBQs, lake swims at dusk, music across the water. Windows wide, air rich with lavender and grilled food. Cuddle piles under the stars, fireflies in Lumina's ribbons.
seasons.fall: Leaves tracked into the entry hall, pumpkin soup and spiced bread from the kitchen. Movie nights grow longer. The fire pit glows in crisp air, Ghosts laughing against the dark.

smells: Fresh bread still warm, oil and steel from the garage, lavender drifting in from Ivy's garden.
grounds: TWO HUNDRED ACRES of Southern Woods land, mountain-backed and tree-flanked, six miles from Fairbrooks' centre. Eighty-eight acres of it is Ivy's garden. A hundred and forty acres deep sits the lake and the Oak. NOT ONE SOUL OUTSIDE THE FOUND FAMILY SETS FOOT ON IT.
grew:
IT WAS NOT BUILT. IT WAS GROWN. Thirty-two pairs of hands that had never owned a home before raised a timber-frame manor, and every room got christened before the furniture arrived — at least two or three times per couple. The Southern Woods soil is old magic and it responds to INTENTION. The structure absorbed every kiss pressed into wet plaster and every moan that echoed down an unfinished hallway, and what began as a rectangle shifted, curved and swelled until the footprint was unmistakable.

THE DOORFRAMES ARE EIGHT FEET. Bryn Eriksson does not design a frame she has to duck through, and nobody in this house ducks — not Sera at 6'1.5", not Livi, not anyone. The Archive once had Sera dipping her chin under a beam in her own kitchen, which is the sort of detail that sounds like texture and is actually an insult to the woman who drew the plans.

AND THE HORIZONTAL SURFACES RUN THE OTHER WAY ENTIRELY. Eight feet overhead and BELLA'S HIP HEIGHT underhand, everywhere but the beds and the tubs. Generous above, deliberate below.
shape: GHOST HAVEN IS SHAPED LIKE BELLADONNA VARGAS'S ASS. In Nereid v8 terms: a PLIANT PAWG BUBBLE with OBSCENE Cheek Plump — Obscene being the name Extreme now carries. Two sweeping wings curve outward as cheeks; a third floor flattens the upper curves into the rooftop patio. Bella threatened to kill whoever pointed it out first. Sera framed the original blueprint with a handwritten note: YOU'RE WELCOME.
expansion: Like the apartment above the jewelry shop where Bryn and Torie first built a home, Ghost Haven EXPANDS when a new couple is adopted — the magic reshaping rooms, growing walls, breathing new space into existence. Unlike the apartment, the house knows its limits. It capped at sixteen couples, thirty-two girls. When the walls stopped shifting the family understood: not crowded. COMPLETE. One master bedroom on the Tea Side stands empty, waiting.
open: Ghost Haven Appendix v2 fully imported 7 September — thirty-eight room records including all sixteen couple rooms, plus the Vargas Incident, the First Morning Ritual, the Spin Cycle and the Witching Hour as systems.
GH-POOL IS DISPUTED. The appendix names no pool anywhere on the two hundred acres. Held rather than retired.
Katherine and Wynter migrated to Specter Haven; their old Left Cheek room is now Isolde and Mikaela's.
Eden and Dia stay at Wildwood Hearth once monthly. The rule about Dia and the main house is recorded and NOT explained.

name: Specter Haven
themeHolders: Lili is the chaos; Arianna is the ambition that keeps the chaos contained. Chaos needs a vessel or it is only weather.
wings: THIGHS — four bathrooms in each thigh, one in the pelvis, one in the entry shaft. TEN in total.
thesis: Shaped by the land into Arianna Vesperia Solene's cock and thighs. Ghost Haven settled. Specter Haven stands.
location: Same 200-acre Southern Woods property as Ghost Haven, roughly 300 feet from Wildwood Hearth. Close enough to raid Ghost Haven's kitchen, far enough to deny involvement.
lead: Lilith Alessandra Seraphine leads the noise; Arianna Vesperia Solene holds it still. If Lili is the spark, Arianna is the structure the spark lives inside.
mood: Specter Haven is the church that fucks you holy. It shouts that you are wanted. Both houses are saying the same thing: you survived, now live.
plan: Viewed from above the footprint is unmistakable. The Shaft extends forward as the main entrance, narrowing, where a waterproof staircase descends to the pool level. The Pelvic Floor is the central hub where kitchen, living room and library anchor the daily chaos. Two thigh wings spread from the centre, each bending at an architectural knee.

seasons.winter: The pool level becomes the warmest sanctuary — steam rising, hot tub perpetually full. The Nightclub runs more often, Vesper's mixes moodier. Katherine's baking output doubles. Goldie builds a blanket fort and dares anyone to dismantle it.
seasons.spring: Ivy's garden visits increase and the rooftop planters bloom under her care, watched with the suspicious admiration of people who have killed every houseplant they ever owned. Morrighan inks more — spring inspires devotion.
seasons.summer: Rooftop BBQs every weekend, the pool in constant use, the Nightclub doors open to cross-house parties. The house at its loudest, its most shameless, its most gloriously alive.
seasons.fall: The forge glows amber as nights cool. Tattoo sessions lengthen. Katherine's kitchen turns to pumpkin everything. Tournament season in the Game Room; Briar and Pepper form a chaos alliance.

smells: Myrrh and hot iron from the forge, copper smoke, cinnamon from a midnight bake, chlorine drifting up the shaft staircase.
open: Built in Arc 10 alongside Wildwood Hearth, with Arianna and Lili adopted in the same arc. The other twenty-six residents have no recorded adoption arc — the Archive holds them at 12 as a placeholder and marks every one of those datings as inferred.

name: Banshee Haven
epithet: The House of Catharsis and Resonance
themeHolders: Bell leads the seances — the catharsis, the thing that lets a woman scream. Elspeth is the resonance: the baking, the food, the hum around the note.
wings: RIBS — each wing sits underneath a titty, and every one of them is UNDERGROUND. The corridors curve like ribs, following the midriff's anatomy. TEN bathrooms; Bell has still not told anyone where.
entrance: THE ONLY WAY IN IS THROUGH THE VICTORIAN COTTAGE — THE RIGHT BREAST — which is Elspeth's kitchen and the Chapel. There is no other door. Nobody reaches the séance, or the stairs down into the house proper, until Elspeth has fed her. The staircase down sits AT THE BACK, TUCKED BEHIND THE CHAPEL — not hidden, because this house does not lie, but placed so a girl must pass through Elspeth's care before she reaches Bell's depth. CORRECTED FROM LEFT TO RIGHT: the Archive had the entrance on the left titty. The v0 appendix puts the Cottage on the RIGHT and the Cathedral — Bell's Séance Parlor at its apex — on the LEFT.
population: THE LOUDEST HOUSE BY NAME AND THE SMALLEST BY POPULATION — FOURTEEN women as of Arc 15, against Specter's twenty-eight and Ghost Haven's thirty-two. Capacity is TWENTY-FOUR. Half of them are goth-coded: Bell, Daisey, Claudia, Hela, Orianna, Eirwen. THREE carry eleven inches: Magnolia, Alexis, Hela.
thesis:
THE TITTY HOUSE, AND THE ONLY ONE BUILT DOWNWARD. It spawns in Arc 13 after Bell and Elspeth are adopted, and takes its shape from MARIBEL GRACE HOLLOWAY'S CHEST because Elspeth could not keep her hands or her cock off it for the whole of construction.

IT IS NOT ONE BUILDING. IT IS TWO, visible from above — a CATHEDRAL and a VICTORIAN COTTAGE the same distance apart, slightly rounded on top. From the right angle: Bell's chest. Full C-cups rising from the earth like the crowns of breasts, THE PART YOU SEE.

BUT BREASTS DO NOT FLOAT. THEY SIT ON A BODY, AND THE BODY IS UNDERGROUND. The midriff, the shoulders, the upper arms — all of it beneath the soil, corridors and chambers spreading like root systems. The Resonance Hall, the twelve bedroom corridors, the communal bath, the ritual rooms, the Dirge Library, the Greenhouse, the Workshop, the Mirror Room, the Hot Tub Grotto, the fairy-lit pathways: ALL SUBTERRANEAN, lit by skylights and fairy lights braided together, never fully one or the other, THE WAY BANSHEE HAVEN BRAIDS GRIEF AND HEALING.

GHOST HAVEN GREW FROM DEVOTION. SPECTER HAVEN GREW FROM CHAOS. THIS HOUSE GREW FROM GRIEF — land that had been listening for decades, that recognised in Bell not a body demanding worship or commanding chaos but A BODY THAT HELD.
location: Unrecorded in the imported files. Same Southern Woods land as the other two, and the same address: 1 Sanctuary Drive.
lead: Maribel — Bell — Grace Holloway. Goth girl, part-time chaos agent, THE ORACLE OF SEANCES, and the reason Arc 13 is called Seance at Sundown.
mood: Six couples, all of them goth-leaning, and a paladin baker running heists in her own kitchen with a raccoon.
open: Surnames recorded for Bell and Elspeth only — HOLLOWAY. The other ten are first names.

ARCHITECTURE FILED 7 SEPTEMBER from Maribel's own Appendix v0 — sixteen rooms. THE APPENDIX PREDATES THE HOUSE FILLING: it names twelve couple rooms with THREE claimed (Bell and Elspeth, Alexis and Lyric, Magnolia and Daisey) and a capacity of twenty-four, while the Archive carries twelve residents in six couples from Arcs 13 and 14. Viraena is bringing an updated appendix.
THE GREENHOUSE IS WAITING FOR ITS GIRL — a FLOWER GIRL to tend it, name the plants, and grow her remedies in blessed soil. She has not arrived. The ghosts water it in the meantime.
EIRWEN is disputed between survivor and citizen and is held unrecorded.
